scenarios.scenario_abstract: Traveling from the UK, [X] and a partner divide one mid-range March week in Zanzibar among Stone Town, transfers between coastal bases, boat and snorkeling days, water sports, forest walking, and resort time, bringing a dry carrier only when the day's contents and wet exposure require it.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]与伴侣从英国出发，把三月一周的中等预算桑给巴尔行程分成石头城、海岸住宿点之间的转移、乘船与浮潜、水上运动、森林步行和度假村休息，并只在当天物品和涉水程度确有需要时携带防水包。
examples: using Travel for inter-base transfers and the full trip load
using Beach or Sports/Fitness for snorkeling, boating, kite surfing, or paddleboarding days
using Outdoor for the forest and mangrove walk while leaving a resort-only day outside that role

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before an R&B stadium concert, [X] chooses among a policy-compliant transparent crossbody, a tiny clutch, secure clothing pockets, or no external bag while accounting for entry screening, dancing, steep seating, a visible phone, and the walk back to the car.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一场 R&B 体育场演唱会前，[X]要在合规透明斜挎包、极小手拿包、带安全口袋的衣物或完全不带外包之间选择，同时考虑入场安检、跳舞、陡峭看台、可见手机，以及散场后步行返回汽车等环节。
examples: using Concert/Festival when the clear-bag rule, crowd movement, and repeated phone access define the carrier
rejecting Travel merely because the attendee drives to the venue
rejecting Party when the source is specifically a ticketed stadium performance rather than a private celebration

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After recently starting to commute by public transport, [X] evaluates one named Swissgear laptop backpack for carrying a fifteen-inch computer, notebooks, water, chargers, keys, wallet, and identification into a professional setting every day without looking bulky.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始乘公共交通通勤后，[X]会评估一款有明确型号的 Swissgear 笔记本电脑背包，准备用它每天把 15 英寸电脑、笔记本、水、充电器、钥匙、钱包和证件带进专业环境，同时避免外观看起来过于臃肿。
examples: using Work/Office because the fixed load, daily commute, and professional appearance are all explicit
not relabeling the backpack as School solely because it carries notebooks
not relabeling it as Travel solely because a trolley sleeve is mentioned as an optional feature

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a two-week trip that includes hiking, [X] selects one backpack that can handle long-distance packing, secure access in crowded places, and stable load transfer on trail days without sacrificing the fit established during the try-on.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为包含徒步活动的两周旅行挑选一只背包时，[X]要求同一个包既能承担长途装载、在人多场所安全取物，也能在徒步日稳定转移负重，同时不牺牲试背时确认的贴合度。
examples: using Travel when the two-week trip and complete luggage role dominate
using Outdoor when the stable frame, harness, and trekking attachment points become the active constraint
using Sports/Fitness only for the hiking segments rather than every transfer day

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a mother's birthday, [X] considers a small backpack or tote because she takes regular walks, needs room for a few essentials, dresses casually, favors purple, and would appreciate something useful within a seventy-euro budget.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为母亲准备生日礼物时，[X]之所以考虑小背包或托特包，是因为母亲经常散步、需要装少量随身物品、穿衣休闲且偏爱紫色，而且礼物要在 70 欧元内保持实用。
examples: using Sports/Fitness when the bag's intended repeated use is recreational walking
not calling the intended use Party merely because the item is a birthday gift
not claiming Travel when no trip or overnight load appears in the source

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When [X] needs to take prepared pasta to work but cannot always refrigerate it overnight, the routine shifts to morning assembly, shelf-stable alternatives, or an insulated lunch carrier with ice packs so the meal remains safe until the workday break.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 当[X]需要把做好的意面带去工作、却无法保证整夜冷藏时，会把流程改成清晨组装、改用常温稳定食品，或使用带冰袋的保温午餐包，使餐食安全保存到工作日休息时间。
examples: using Work/Office because the carrier solves a recurring workday meal-storage problem
not classifying the same bag as Travel merely because it moves between home and work
keeping the occasion stable even when the meal changes from pasta to a shelf-stable lunch

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Within a dated Buenos Aires itinerary, [X] reserves one stop for comparing leather bags and artisan carriers across a crowded Sunday market, convenient pedestrian shops, and an upscale gallery, while planning how to carry the purchase back through the city.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一份有明确日期的布宜诺斯艾利斯行程中，[X]专门安排一站，在拥挤的周日市集、便捷的步行街商店和高档商场之间比较皮包与手作包，并提前考虑购买后如何带着商品穿过城市。
examples: using Shopping when browsing, authenticity, price tier, and carrying the purchase are central
using Travel only when the bag is evaluated as a souvenir that must return with the traveler
not calling the market visit Party despite street performers and a lively atmosphere

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For graduation, [X] completes a formal, glamorous look around a floral dress and chest ruffles and considers a compact pearl or metallic clutch that can hold ceremony essentials without competing with the dress, jewelry, platform shoes, or time spent standing and walking.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为毕业场合准备造型时，[X]围绕花卉连衣裙和胸前荷叶边完善正式又华丽的搭配，并考虑一只小巧的珍珠或金属感手拿包，用来装典礼必需品，同时不与裙装、首饰、厚底鞋以及长时间站立行走的需要冲突。
examples: using Formal Event because graduation ceremony dress, polish, and compact essentials are the active constraints
not treating the same source as School merely because the user is graduating
not treating the clutch as Party unless a separate celebration is actually established

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While organizing an outdoor luncheon for twenty-five friends who play golf, [X] includes a compact golf-themed crossbody bag in a playful dress code; it must work with lawn activities, group photographs, food and drinks, and a polished social theme without becoming sports equipment.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为 25 位喜欢高尔夫的朋友组织户外午宴时，[X]在趣味着装规范中加入带高尔夫元素的小巧斜挎包；它要适应草坪活动、集体合影、餐饮和精致社交主题，同时又不能被误作运动器材包。
examples: using Party when the carrier is part of a themed social luncheon and group-photo dress code
using Outdoor when sun, lawn movement, and open-air setup control the load
using Formal Event only for the more polished interpretation rather than assuming every golf luncheon is formal

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While studying business in Madrid, [X] compares named low-profile backpacks for carrying a costly laptop and peripherals between classes, study sessions, and cafes, wanting the carrier to resemble an ordinary campus lifestyle bag while protecting a mobile workstation.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在马德里读商科期间，[X]会比较几款有明确品牌或型号的低调背包，用于在课堂、自习和咖啡馆之间携带昂贵电脑与外设；包需要看起来像普通校园生活背包，同时能保护移动工作站。
examples: using School because classes, study sessions, and the student's academic equipment define the repeated role
using Work/Office only if the later dialogue activates the source's freelance or professional use rather than assuming it
not using Travel for ordinary movement among Madrid cafes and campus locations
